notes: WArmy 0.4.5: smarter working budget — follow-up tool calls are now gated by the prediction ledger (past predictions, overruns, corrections) instead of a fixed count; round/result ceilings raised with prediction-based review as the primary gate and a generous safety net; follow-up turns carry the model own ETA estimate (and a correction prompt when it slips); clear rules for when to read files: read before editing an existing file, only the needed parts, and big files are read in chunks with an on-disk running summary before computing results.
